concepts: Time boundaries, hybrid tables and upserts
key_terms: A logical Pinot table backed by an OFFLINE table for historical data and a REALTIME table for fresh data.
The timestamp the broker uses to split a hybrid query, reading older data from the offline side and newer data from the real-time side.
A real-time table mode that keeps only the latest record for each primary key.
The column an upsert table uses to decide which record for a primary key is newest.
evidence: Prepared actual Pinot Docker workshop and explicitly scoped extensions. Qualification ledger distinguishes source, native service acceptance, indexes, streaming, hybrid/upsert and multistage observations.
